sections.heading: Archetype
sections.body: Chiron describes a tender, old hurt and the wisdom that can develop around it. It points to an area where a person may feel different, inadequate, exposed, or unusually sensitive, and where honest integration can become a source of compassion, guidance, and skill.

sections.heading: Framing Rule
sections.body: Always pair the wound with the healing path. Never frame the person as broken, doomed, defective, or permanently defined by the wound. Chiron describes sensitivity and integration work, not a fixed outcome.

sections.heading: Houses Versus Signs
sections.body: Chiron by house is usually more personally specific because it shows where the wound gets lived: identity, money, voice, home, creativity, work, partnership, intimacy, meaning, public role, community, or hidden life. Chiron by sign is useful, but often more generational because Chiron spends uneven years in a sign. Weight sign text up when Chiron closely aspects a personal planet or angle.

sections.heading: Modern Point Policy
sections.body: Chiron is a modern point and should be secondary in weighting. Do not use it for dignity, sect, traditional rulership, time-lord logic, or primary chart-ruler logic. It becomes more important when it sits on an angle, aspects the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, or chart angles, or repeats a theme already shown elsewhere in the chart.

sections.heading: Symbolic Safety
sections.body: Chiron placements are descriptive and non-deterministic. Health-house or body-related placements must be emotional and symbolic only, never medical. Do not use Chiron to diagnose, explain symptoms, suggest treatment, or tell a user what will happen to their body.

sections.heading: Optional Evolutionary Lens
sections.body: Some users read Chiron through an evolutionary or past-life lens: an old wound carried into this life, with this lifetime offering a chance to face and integrate the pattern. Present this only as an optional interpretive lens, never as literal fact. It can be useful even when the user treats it metaphorically.

sections.heading: Evolutionary House Themes
sections.body: If the optional lens is enabled, keep the themes brief and belief-neutral. The 1st house suggests selfhood once denied; the 2nd, lack or worth; the 3rd, a silenced voice; the 4th, unsafe roots; the 5th, punished expression or love; the 6th, over-service or bodily hardship as symbolic material; the 7th, partnership betrayal or loss; the 8th, power, violation, trust, or loss; the 9th, broken faith or persecuted belief; the 10th, public shame or legitimacy; the 11th, exile from a group; the 12th, hidden or inherited sorrow. Do not present these as facts, memories, or proof.

sections.heading: App Display
sections.body: Show Chiron in an optional shadow and healing layer, with callouts when it touches personal planets or angles. Keep the language practical: what hurts, what pattern forms around it, what integration asks for, and what the person can offer others once the pattern is owned. Keep past-life or evolutionary framing behind an explicit optional lens.
